source_summaries.name: Nigerian built-environment regulators and bodies
Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria competency and registration guidance
Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria registration guidance
COREN 2026 engineering regulation and public-safety reforms
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian engineering practice, registration, public safety, project monitoring and anti-quackery context
findings: COREN's 2026 reforms emphasise qualified and registered practitioners, public safety, project monitoring and enforcement against unqualified engineering practice.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports regulated-engineering context; it is not a personal registration requirement for every technician or non-engineering role in an engineering organisation.

source_summaries.name: COREN and Nigerian Society of Engineers
Federal Government Nigerian welding, fabrication, foundry and instrumentation bootcamp
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian youth technical training in welding, fabrication, foundry, metallurgy, instrumentation, control and mechanical maintenance
findings: The Federal Government reported training 535 Nigerian youths in welding and fabrication and related metals, instrumentation, control and mechanical-maintenance areas.
source_summaries.limitations: The bootcamp is a skills-development signal and not a universal certificate or evidence that every metal-trade role is currently hiring.

source_summaries.name: HotNigerianJobs metallurgical and materials engineering vacancy snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian metallurgical, materials, steel and welding-related vacancies
findings: The Nigerian discipline page listed metallurgical and materials engineering vacancies, including steel melt-shop and mechanical/metallurgical engineering roles, with welding and fabrication qualifications appearing in requirements.
source_summaries.limitations: Job listings are time-bound and title conventions vary; this is an observed market signal, not a national demand estimate or universal qualification requirement.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Nigeria mining titles, geoscience and oil-and-gas local-content training framework
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian mineral titles, exploration, quarrying, mining operations, geoscience, drilling, oil-and-gas technical training, local-content competence and NOGICJQS-linked certification
findings: The Mining Cadastre Office identifies reconnaissance, exploration, small-scale mining, quarry and mining leases and administers mineral titles.
NCDMB describes competence-based classroom, practical, on-the-job training and certification across petroleum/geosciences, drilling, production, engineering, HSE and related sectors.
source_summaries.limitations: A mineral title or NOGICJQS/training requirement applies to the relevant activity or project, not automatically to every worker in a mining or energy-adjacent subgroup.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
Nigerian Association of Metallurgical and Materials Engineers role-context publication
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian metallurgical and materials engineering role families
findings: The publication identifies Nigerian role families including metallurgical engineer, foundry technician and welding/inspection engineer across steel, aluminium, copper, foundry and upstream or midstream settings.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional role context does not establish current vacancy volume or that every role requires professional registration.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Nuclear Regulatory Authority radiation-safety training for mining
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian solid-mineral mining and processing radiation-safety roles and adjacent technical occupations
findings: NNRA announced a 2026 national course for current or prospective Radiation Safety Officers in mining and mineral processing, covering NORM/TE-NORM, monitoring, dose assessment, radiation protection, handling, transport, waste management and regulatory compliance.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a specialised radiation-safety pathway and does not apply to every mining or geology role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian mineral titles, exploration, quarrying, mining operations, geoscience, drilling, oil-and-gas technical training, local-content competence and NOGICJQS-linked certification
findings: The Mining Cadastre Office identifies reconnaissance, exploration, small-scale mining, quarry and mining leases and administers mineral titles.
NCDMB describes competence-based classroom, practical, on-the-job training and certification across petroleum/geosciences, drilling, production, engineering, HSE and related sectors.
source_summaries.limitations: A mineral title or NOGICJQS/training requirement applies to the relevant activity or project, not automatically to every worker in a mining or energy-adjacent subgroup.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
Nigerian Association of Metallurgical and Materials Engineers role-context publication
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian metallurgical and materials engineering role families
findings: The publication identifies Nigerian role families including metallurgical engineer, foundry technician and welding/inspection engineer across steel, aluminium, copper, foundry and upstream or midstream settings.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional role context does not establish current vacancy volume or that every role requires professional registration.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Nuclear Regulatory Authority radiation-safety training for mining
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian solid-mineral mining and processing radiation-safety roles and adjacent technical occupations
findings: NNRA announced a 2026 national course for current or prospective Radiation Safety Officers in mining and mineral processing, covering NORM/TE-NORM, monitoring, dose assessment, radiation protection, handling, transport, waste management and regulatory compliance.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a specialised radiation-safety pathway and does not apply to every mining or geology role.

Council for the Regulation of Freight Forwarding in Nigeria membership requirements
CRFFN freight-forwarding and supply-chain professional pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian freight forwarding, cargo clearance and supply-chain practice
findings: CRFFN regulates and sets competence standards for freight forwarding in Nigeria.
The council describes Certificate in Freight Forwarding, FIATA Diploma and Higher Diploma pathways and accredited training providers.
source_summaries.limitations: The professional pathway applies to freight-forwarding practice; it is not a universal credential requirement for every warehouse, transport or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Procurement Certification Programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public and private procurement practitioners
findings: The programme describes four Nigerian procurement-certification tiers and skills including communication, teamwork, time management, deadlines, ethics and risk management, with prerequisites varying by tier.
source_summaries.limitations: The pathway is for procurement practice and does not apply to every purchasing, logistics, project or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: Project Managers Development Association of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project-management professional development and IPMA-aligned certification levels
findings: PMDAN identifies itself as Nigeria's IPMA member association, describes four certification levels and publishes project-execution and project-management learning activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional-body certification is a pathway, not a universal employer requirement for every project-support or coordination role.

Council for the Regulation of Freight Forwarding in Nigeria membership requirements
CRFFN freight-forwarding and supply-chain professional pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian freight forwarding, cargo clearance and supply-chain practice
findings: CRFFN regulates and sets competence standards for freight forwarding in Nigeria.
The council describes Certificate in Freight Forwarding, FIATA Diploma and Higher Diploma pathways and accredited training providers.
source_summaries.limitations: The professional pathway applies to freight-forwarding practice; it is not a universal credential requirement for every warehouse, transport or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Procurement Certification Programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public and private procurement practitioners
findings: The programme describes four Nigerian procurement-certification tiers and skills including communication, teamwork, time management, deadlines, ethics and risk management, with prerequisites varying by tier.
source_summaries.limitations: The pathway is for procurement practice and does not apply to every purchasing, logistics, project or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: Project Managers Development Association of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project-management professional development and IPMA-aligned certification levels
findings: PMDAN identifies itself as Nigeria's IPMA member association, describes four certification levels and publishes project-execution and project-management learning activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional-body certification is a pathway, not a universal employer requirement for every project-support or coordination role.

CRFFN freight-forwarding and supply-chain professional pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian freight forwarding, cargo clearance and supply-chain practice
findings: CRFFN regulates and sets competence standards for freight forwarding in Nigeria.
The council describes Certificate in Freight Forwarding, FIATA Diploma and Higher Diploma pathways and accredited training providers.
source_summaries.limitations: The professional pathway applies to freight-forwarding practice; it is not a universal credential requirement for every warehouse, transport or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

Nigerian creative-industry and media sources
Directors Guild of Nigeria Academy
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film and television directing, screenwriting, cinematography and production management
findings: DGN Academy describes practical and theoretical training for directors, filmmakers, students and emerging creatives, including directing, screenwriting, cinematography and production management.
source_summaries.limitations: Guild training is a pathway signal and does not establish a universal licence or employment guarantee.

source_summaries.name: Esports Federation of Nigeria national esports programmes
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian competitive gaming, schools and university esports, broadcasting, refereeing, tournament operations and team programmes
findings: The federation described a National Esports Championship, Team Nigeria programme, schools and university league, and training for referees, broadcasters and tournament officials.
source_summaries.limitations: Federation programmes demonstrate ecosystem and role-family context; they do not establish national job volume or a mandatory credential.

source_summaries.name: Federal Ministry of Arts, Culture, Tourism and the Creative Economy gaming sector context
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria gaming, game development, esports and immersive creative economy
findings: Government identifies game development, esports and immersive experiences as a Nigerian creative-economy growth area.
The ministry describes local talent support, digital-skills development and job creation as sector objectives.
source_summaries.limitations: Sector policy context is not a count of vacancies and does not establish an individual licence or credential requirement.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Theatre production and technical-theatre ecosystem
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian stage production, technical theatre, performance and cultural programming
findings: The National Theatre identifies production and technical-theatre services and operates as a Nigerian hub for artistic expression and cultural production.
source_summaries.limitations: Institutional context does not establish a role-specific vacancy, salary or credential requirement.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE Creative Content Production curriculum
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian audio-visual content, cinematography, sound, editing and scriptwriting
findings: The curriculum includes background music and sound effects, cinematography, shot lists, storyboarding, lighting, screen directing and introductory scriptwriting.
source_summaries.limitations: Curriculum evidence supports skills and learning routes, not role-level demand or a universal credential requirement.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Skills Qualification Creative Media Production standard
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film, video and creative-media production
findings: The standard covers storytelling, plot, cinematography, sound, production design, editing, performance, genre, special effects, cameras, lighting and camera gear.
source_summaries.limitations: The occupational standard is a skills/training reference and does not imply that every production role requires a separate licence.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications list
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Copyright Commission music and creative-economy rights framework
Nigerian Film Corporation creative-media National Occupational Standards workshop
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian creative-media trades including film, audio, content, photography, animation, graphics, broadcasting, gaming and immersive technologies
findings: The Nigerian Film Corporation reported a July 2026 critique and validation workshop intended to develop National Occupational Standards for creative-media trades, including film production, audio production, content creation, digital photography, animation, digital graphics, broadcasting, gaming and immersive technologies.
source_summaries.limitations: The workshop demonstrates Nigerian standardisation activity and named trade families; it does not mean final standards or a personal certificate already exist for every listed role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Film Corporation film, sound, camera and audiovisual training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film production, camera, sound, video, editing, audiovisual training, archives and National Film Institute pathways
findings: NFC describes its film-industry development, National Film Institute courses, training, film production, archiving and National Film Video and Sound Archive responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports Nigerian audiovisual training and sector context, not one universal commercial camera, audio or editing stack.

source_summaries.name: National Film and Video Censors Board film classification and distribution licensing
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film/video classification, legal distribution and exhibition
findings: NFVCB states that films and video works must be classified before distribution or exhibition and provides online, national, regional and community distributor-licence categories.
source_summaries.limitations: These requirements apply to film works, distributors and exhibition activity; they are not automatically a personal licence for actors, editors, camera operators or technicians.

source_summaries.name: National Institute of Marketing of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian marketing professional standards, training, certification and continuing development
findings: NIMN describes itself as the chartered regulatory body for marketing professionals in Nigeria and identifies training, certification, professional standards and ethics as part of its mandate.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports marketing-profession context; it does not establish a required certification for every marketing, sales, communications or brand role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Institute of Professional Administrators and Office Technology and Management
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian office administration, secretarial administration and office-technology professional training/certification
findings: NIPAS publishes professional certification and examination procedures for office administration and office-technology candidates.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a professional training/membership route, not a universal statutory licence for every office administrator.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Investment Promotion Commission creative-economy sector map
source_summaries.scope: Film, music, fashion, live entertainment, digital content, animation, gaming, XR, arts and cultural tourism in Nigeria
findings: The NIPC sector page identifies film, music, fashion, live entertainment, digital content, animation, gaming and XR among Nigeria's creative-economy activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Sector mapping shows an established Nigerian sector context; it does not establish role-level hiring volume or a required tool stack.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Institute of Translators and Interpreters accreditation and membership examination
Nigerian Press Council journalism ethics and training accreditation
Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian quantity-surveying practice and professional registration context
findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

source_summaries.name: SMEDAN Nigerian founder, MSME, entrepreneurship and business-development training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian MSME capacity building, entrepreneurship training, business development, access to finance, market support and founder development
findings: SMEDAN describes entrepreneurship training, capacity building, finance, markets and founder support for Nigerian nano, micro and small enterprises.
source_summaries.limitations: This supports entrepreneurial and business-development foundations; it does not establish a universal founder credential, company-registration outcome or demand ranking for every management role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian XR and immersive-technology ecosystem signals
source_summaries.scope: Lagos and Nigerian AR/VR/XR training, immersive media, education, healthcare and construction use cases
findings: Lagos XR ecosystem sources describe skills including 360 video, Unity, Unreal Engine, event planning and team leadership; local reporting also describes VR training and Nigerian immersive-technology education and emergency-services use cases.
source_summaries.limitations: These are ecosystem and training signals, not evidence of a national vacancy count or universal tool requirement.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian creative-media trades including film, audio, content, photography, animation, graphics, broadcasting, gaming and immersive technologies
findings: The Nigerian Film Corporation reported a July 2026 critique and validation workshop intended to develop National Occupational Standards for creative-media trades, including film production, audio production, content creation, digital photography, animation, digital graphics, broadcasting, gaming and immersive technologies.
source_summaries.limitations: The workshop demonstrates Nigerian standardisation activity and named trade families; it does not mean final standards or a personal certificate already exist for every listed role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Film Corporation film, sound, camera and audiovisual training context

source_summaries.limitations: The source supports Nigerian audiovisual training and sector context, not one universal commercial camera, audio or editing stack.

source_summaries.name: National Film and Video Censors Board film classification and distribution licensing
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film/video classification, legal distribution and exhibition
findings: NFVCB states that films and video works must be classified before distribution or exhibition and provides online, national, regional and community distributor-licence categories.
source_summaries.limitations: These requirements apply to film works, distributors and exhibition activity; they are not automatically a personal licence for actors, editors, camera operators or technicians.

source_summaries.name: National Institute of Marketing of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian marketing professional standards, training, certification and continuing development
findings: NIMN describes itself as the chartered regulatory body for marketing professionals in Nigeria and identifies training, certification, professional standards and ethics as part of its mandate.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports marketing-profession context; it does not establish a required certification for every marketing, sales, communications or brand role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Institute of Professional Administrators and Office Technology and Management
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian office administration, secretarial administration and office-technology professional training/certification
findings: NIPAS publishes professional certification and examination procedures for office administration and office-technology candidates.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a professional training/membership route, not a universal statutory licence for every office administrator.

source_summaries.name: Bureau of Public Service Reforms National Strategy for Public Service Reform
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian civil-service administration, competency, performance, accountability and professionalisation
findings: The strategy describes a professional, results-oriented, competent, accountable and citizen-centred Nigerian public service, including merit-based recruitment, performance management, job evaluation and professionalisation of core cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: A reform strategy supplies public-service capability context, not a universal qualification for every public or private-sector role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian sector-skills governance and occupational-standard development across ICT, engineering, transport/logistics and other sectors
findings: The guidelines describe sector-skills-council structures used to coordinate occupational standards, industry participation and skills development in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: The guidelines support skills-governance context and do not establish a credential or demand signal for an individual role.

Nigeria Procurement Certification Programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public and private procurement practitioners
findings: The programme describes four Nigerian procurement-certification tiers and skills including communication, teamwork, time management, deadlines, ethics and risk management, with prerequisites varying by tier.
source_summaries.limitations: The pathway is for procurement practice and does not apply to every purchasing, logistics, project or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: OHCSF Personnel Audit and Skills Gap Analysis project
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian federal civil-service skills identification, development and gap analysis
findings: The OHCSF PASGA portal describes a project to identify and develop the skills of Nigerian public servants and build a data-driven, globally competitive civil service.
source_summaries.limitations: The portal is public-service skills context and does not establish a private-sector requirement or a single certification.

source_summaries.name: Project Managers Development Association of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project-management professional development and IPMA-aligned certification levels
findings: PMDAN identifies itself as Nigeria's IPMA member association, describes four certification levels and publishes project-execution and project-management learning activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional-body certification is a pathway, not a universal employer requirement for every project-support or coordination role.

source_summaries.name: Project Management Institute Nigeria Chapter professional development and certification pathway
Federal Government social-work professionalisation and standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian social-work practice, professionalisation, standards and capacity-building context
findings: The Federal Government described work to strengthen social-work practice in Nigeria, including professionalisation and standards challenges under the Social Work Practitioners Act 2022 context.
source_summaries.limitations: The article supports Nigerian practice context but does not establish one compulsory credential for every care, counselling or social-service role.

source_summaries.name: TRCN safeguarding resources for Nigerian schools
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian child protection, learner safety, violence-free schools and safeguarding practice
findings: TRCN provides resources on child protection, safety, security and violence-free schools and describes protocols and standards for protecting children and learners.
source_summaries.limitations: Safeguarding resources support education and child-facing practice; they do not create one universal certificate for all social-service or childcare roles.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian civil-service administration, competency, performance, accountability and professionalisation
findings: The strategy describes a professional, results-oriented, competent, accountable and citizen-centred Nigerian public service, including merit-based recruitment, performance management, job evaluation and professionalisation of core cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: A reform strategy supplies public-service capability context, not a universal qualification for every public or private-sector role.

Nigeria Procurement Certification Programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public and private procurement practitioners
findings: The programme describes four Nigerian procurement-certification tiers and skills including communication, teamwork, time management, deadlines, ethics and risk management, with prerequisites varying by tier.
source_summaries.limitations: The pathway is for procurement practice and does not apply to every purchasing, logistics, project or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: OHCSF Personnel Audit and Skills Gap Analysis project
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian federal civil-service skills identification, development and gap analysis
findings: The OHCSF PASGA portal describes a project to identify and develop the skills of Nigerian public servants and build a data-driven, globally competitive civil service.
source_summaries.limitations: The portal is public-service skills context and does not establish a private-sector requirement or a single certification.

source_summaries.name: Project Managers Development Association of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project-management professional development and IPMA-aligned certification levels
findings: PMDAN identifies itself as Nigeria's IPMA member association, describes four certification levels and publishes project-execution and project-management learning activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional-body certification is a pathway, not a universal employer requirement for every project-support or coordination role.

source_summaries.name: Project Management Institute Nigeria Chapter professional development and certification pathway
Federal Government social-work professionalisation and standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian social-work practice, professionalisation, standards and capacity-building context
findings: The Federal Government described work to strengthen social-work practice in Nigeria, including professionalisation and standards challenges under the Social Work Practitioners Act 2022 context.
source_summaries.limitations: The article supports Nigerian practice context but does not establish one compulsory credential for every care, counselling or social-service role.

source_summaries.name: TRCN safeguarding resources for Nigerian schools
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian child protection, learner safety, violence-free schools and safeguarding practice
findings: TRCN provides resources on child protection, safety, security and violence-free schools and describes protocols and standards for protecting children and learners.
source_summaries.limitations: Safeguarding resources support education and child-facing practice; they do not create one universal certificate for all social-service or childcare roles.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction trades including electrical, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting, plumbing and tiling
findings: C-LMIS provides Nigerian construction National Occupational Standards across building trades, including electrical, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decorating, plumbing and tiling.
source_summaries.limitations: The standards support construction-trade skills and pathways; they do not establish a licence for every worker or a universal requirement for construction managers and engineers.

Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy and Microsoft 3MTT workforce programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian digital-skills pathways in AI, cybersecurity, data science and software development
findings: The ministry described 3MTT pathways for AI, cybersecurity, data science and software development and a Microsoft-backed AI skilling programme targeting Nigerian learners.
source_summaries.limitations: A government skilling programme is ecosystem and pathway evidence, not proof that every Nigerian employer requires the programme or its tools.

source_summaries.name: Federal Government Nigerian welding, fabrication, foundry and instrumentation bootcamp
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian youth technical training in welding, fabrication, foundry, metallurgy, instrumentation, control and mechanical maintenance
findings: The Federal Government reported training 535 Nigerian youths in welding and fabrication and related metals, instrumentation, control and mechanical-maintenance areas.
source_summaries.limitations: The bootcamp is a skills-development signal and not a universal certificate or evidence that every metal-trade role is currently hiring.

source_summaries.name: HotNigerianJobs metallurgical and materials engineering vacancy snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian metallurgical, materials, steel and welding-related vacancies
findings: The Nigerian discipline page listed metallurgical and materials engineering vacancies, including steel melt-shop and mechanical/metallurgical engineering roles, with welding and fabrication qualifications appearing in requirements.
source_summaries.limitations: Job listings are time-bound and title conventions vary; this is an observed market signal, not a national demand estimate or universal qualification requirement.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
Nigerian Association of Metallurgical and Materials Engineers role-context publication
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian metallurgical and materials engineering role families
findings: The publication identifies Nigerian role families including metallurgical engineer, foundry technician and welding/inspection engineer across steel, aluminium, copper, foundry and upstream or midstream settings.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional role context does not establish current vacancy volume or that every role requires professional registration.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and curricula
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications list
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and Federal TVET trade pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian vocational and technical pathways including garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web, health and safety and other occupational standards
findings: NBTE's current NOS catalogue names occupational standards and levels for garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web and other trades.
The Federal TVET initiative describes accredited centres, practical skills, employment and entrepreneurship pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: An NOS or TVET pathway is evidence of a Nigerian training route, not a claim that every employer requires the listed level or that one trade credential is interchangeable with a degree or professional licence.

source_summaries.name: Office of the Head of the Civil Service ICT scheme-of-service circular
source_summaries.scope: Federal Nigerian public-service ICT role classification and professional benchmark context
findings: The 2026 circular reports review and harmonisation of federal ICT schemes of service and describes professional benchmarks involving COREN for computer engineers and CPN registration for other IT specialists in the specified public-service progression context.
source_summaries.limitations: The circular applies to the stated public-service scheme and must not be rendered as a blanket private-sector licence requirement.

source_summaries.name: Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian quantity-surveying practice and professional registration context
findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

source_summaries.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria building and construction conference
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction standards, structural integrity, materials, risk management and sustainable development
findings: SON reported a 2024 national conference emphasizing standards practice, structural integrity, sustainable materials and risk management in Nigeria's building and construction industry.
source_summaries.limitations: Conference and standards context does not assign one tool or credential to every construction role.

findings: Jobberman currently exposes Nigerian vacancies across finance, insurance, IT, agriculture, automotive and aviation, legal, healthcare, hospitality, mining and other categories; a listed Financial Analyst vacancy names financial analysis, modelling, reporting and Excel.
The source is used as a dated market signal, not as a complete census of Nigerian hiring or a universal requirement.
source_summaries.limitations: Vacancy counts and titles change; one listing or category count cannot establish a permanent demand ranking, universal skill requirement or licensing rule.

local_demand_signals.limitation: Vacancies and search results are time-bound market signals; they do not establish universal demand, salary or a hiring guarantee.

evidence_search.limitation: The search record documents the Nigerian sources checked by the current resolver; a no-direct result means no defensible exact match was found in those checked sources, not that the occupation or subgroup does not exist.

findings: CBN materials describe payment-service categories, oversight, security, consumer protection, open banking and operational controls.
SEC materials describe capital-market operator registration, pre-registration training and examination, investment-adviser representatives and compliance responsibilities.

source_summaries.limitations: These requirements apply to film works, distributors and exhibition activity; they are not automatically a personal licence for actors, editors, camera operators or technicians.

source_summaries.limitations: Practitioner and enterprise routes differ; neither is a universal credential for every tourism or retail role.

source_summaries.limitations: A national training track is evidence of a Nigerian skills pathway and ecosystem signal, not a guarantee of employment demand or a universal requirement for each related subgroup.

source_summaries.limitations: Sector policy context is not a role-level vacancy count or personal certification requirement.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: Maritime Academy of Nigeria nautical and marine-engineering pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian nautical science, marine engineering, hydrography, port and seafarer training
findings: The Academy describes ND/HND Nautical Science and Marine Engineering and professional courses in maritime safety and seafarer operations.
Its programmes combine academic, laboratory, simulator, safety and practical sea-service preparation.
source_summaries.limitations: Education and training pathways do not guarantee employment or substitute for the exact certificate required for a regulated duty.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer qualification, certification and career progression framework
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer deck, engine, electro-technical and domestic maritime pathways
findings: NIMASA lists Master/Chief Mate, Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch, Able Seafarer Deck, Chief and Second Engineer, Engineering Watch, Electro-Technical Officer and domestic certificates such as River Master, Quarter Master, Marine Engineer Assistant, Coxswain and Motorman.
The framework combines approved education, practical training, sea service and competency certification.
source_summaries.limitations: Certificate-of-competency requirements apply to the relevant seafaring duties; they are not a universal requirement for shore-based maritime work.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian commercial diving and underwater technology training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial diving, underwater technology, offshore safety, SCUBA and competence-based diver training linked to maritime and petroleum-sector work
findings: FUPRE describes diving and underwater-technology competence training and PTI lists commercial-diving-related entry requirements and technical certificate pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: Diving certification depends on the class, depth, equipment, medical fitness, employer and offshore or inshore duty; no single universal Nigerian diver credential is asserted.

source_summaries.limitations: This supports a named training route, not a universal national credential or vacancy count.

source_summaries.name: Federal Ministry of Solid Minerals Development jewellery-making training and industry pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian jewellery making, gemstone value addition, workshop training, production and export-oriented enterprise
findings: The Ministry described a Jewellery Training Centre in Abuja, selected master and advanced students, practical jewellery production training and a policy goal of local value addition and employment.
source_summaries.limitations: The programme is a specific training and industry pathway; it does not establish one universal jewellery licence or demand ranking.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian vocational and technical pathways including garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web, health and safety and other occupational standards
findings: NBTE's current NOS catalogue names occupational standards and levels for garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web and other trades.
The Federal TVET initiative describes accredited centres, practical skills, employment and entrepreneurship pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: An NOS or TVET pathway is evidence of a Nigerian training route, not a claim that every employer requires the listed level or that one trade credential is interchangeable with a degree or professional licence.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority personnel licensing and aviation regulation
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian pilots, aircraft maintenance engineers, dispatchers, air traffic controllers, cabin crew and aeronautical personnel
findings: NCAA is Nigeria's civil-aviation regulator and identifies licensing, certification, inspection, monitoring and enforcement functions.
The personnel licensing framework covers pilots, aircraft maintenance engineers, flight dispatchers, air traffic controllers and related aviation personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: Licensing requirements are role- and operation-specific; the presence of a licence pathway does not mean every aeronautical or airport role requires the same licence.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian College of Aviation Technology training programmes
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian pilot, air-traffic, aircraft-maintenance, aviation-management and aeronautical-technical training
findings: NCAT lists aircraft-maintenance engineering, aviation management and air-traffic services/communications training and is identified as a national aviation specialist-training institution.
source_summaries.limitations: Training availability does not by itself grant a licence or establish a vacancy.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian teacher, technical-instructor and digital-learning training pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian teacher professional development, digital literacy, classroom practice, technical teacher training and education technology implementation
findings: The Federal Ministry of Education's teacher platform describes structured teaching-methodology and digital-literacy modules.
Government education and TVET sources describe technical-teacher training, accredited centres and practical instruction pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support education-workforce and instructor foundations; they do not establish a universal licence or exact hiring requirement for every teaching, training or coaching title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Institute of Transport Technology 2026 railway training programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway communication, signalling, networks, control, cargo, governance, safety, track maintenance, infrastructure and rail administration
findings: NITT lists 2026 railway courses covering communication and signalling, ITS, cargo operations, governance, occupational safety, track-quality monitoring, infrastructure and facility management.
source_summaries.limitations: A training course listing supports a Nigerian pathway and named capability areas; it does not establish a universal personal licence or current vacancy count.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Railway Corporation railway technology transfer and manpower pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway technology transfer, locomotive engineering, rail management and digital rail technology
findings: NRC describes a 2025 partnership with tertiary institutions to build a skilled manpower pipeline in locomotive engineering, rail management and digital rail technology.
source_summaries.limitations: The partnership is an ecosystem and workforce-development signal, not proof that every railway role is currently recruited or that one credential applies to all roles.

findings: The ministry lists a 2024 guideline on integration of medical laboratory services, a 2025 guideline on medical-laboratory quality management, and a 2026 guideline on laboratory biosafety and biosecurity.

source_summaries.name: Bureau of Public Service Reforms National Strategy for Public Service Reform
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian civil-service administration, competency, performance, accountability and professionalisation
findings: The strategy describes a professional, results-oriented, competent, accountable and citizen-centred Nigerian public service, including merit-based recruitment, performance management, job evaluation and professionalisation of core cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: A reform strategy supplies public-service capability context, not a universal qualification for every public or private-sector role.

source_summaries.name: NUC, NCCE and Nigerian education standards
Jobberman Nigeria jobs
MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian early-childhood care, primary education and childcare training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian early-childhood care and education, primary education, childcare settings, NCE minimum standards and learner safeguarding
findings: NCCE minimum standards identify Early Childhood Care and Primary Education as a specialised NCE pathway for early-years and primary teachers.
Federal education sources publish national minimum standards for ECCDE centres.
source_summaries.limitations: Education standards support institution and educator foundations; they do not establish one universal private childcare credential for every nanny, caregiver or family setting.

source_summaries.name: National Universities Commission CCMAS and standards
OHCSF Personnel Audit and Skills Gap Analysis project
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian federal civil-service skills identification, development and gap analysis
findings: The OHCSF PASGA portal describes a project to identify and develop the skills of Nigerian public servants and build a data-driven, globally competitive civil service.
source_summaries.limitations: The portal is public-service skills context and does not establish a private-sector requirement or a single certification.

source_summaries.name: Federal Government social-work professionalisation and standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian social-work practice, professionalisation, standards and capacity-building context
findings: The Federal Government described work to strengthen social-work practice in Nigeria, including professionalisation and standards challenges under the Social Work Practitioners Act 2022 context.
source_summaries.limitations: The article supports Nigerian practice context but does not establish one compulsory credential for every care, counselling or social-service role.

source_summaries.name: TRCN safeguarding resources for Nigerian schools
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian child protection, learner safety, violence-free schools and safeguarding practice
findings: TRCN provides resources on child protection, safety, security and violence-free schools and describes protocols and standards for protecting children and learners.
source_summaries.limitations: Safeguarding resources support education and child-facing practice; they do not create one universal certificate for all social-service or childcare roles.

source_summaries.name: Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria teacher standards and PQE
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian teacher education, accreditation, registration, professional qualifying examination and competency assessment
findings: TRCN describes its responsibility for teacher-education standards, programme accreditation, qualification approval, professional registration and competency assessment; its 2026 updates include PQE results and school-accreditation policy implementation.
source_summaries.limitations: TRCN applies to teaching practice within its mandate, not to every education, training, research or childcare role.

source_summaries.name: Bureau of Public Service Reforms National Strategy for Public Service Reform
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian civil-service administration, competency, performance, accountability and professionalisation
findings: The strategy describes a professional, results-oriented, competent, accountable and citizen-centred Nigerian public service, including merit-based recruitment, performance management, job evaluation and professionalisation of core cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: A reform strategy supplies public-service capability context, not a universal qualification for every public or private-sector role.

source_summaries.name: NUC, NCCE and Nigerian education standards
Jobberman Nigeria jobs
MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian early-childhood care, primary education and childcare training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian early-childhood care and education, primary education, childcare settings, NCE minimum standards and learner safeguarding
findings: NCCE minimum standards identify Early Childhood Care and Primary Education as a specialised NCE pathway for early-years and primary teachers.
Federal education sources publish national minimum standards for ECCDE centres.
source_summaries.limitations: Education standards support institution and educator foundations; they do not establish one universal private childcare credential for every nanny, caregiver or family setting.

source_summaries.name: National Universities Commission CCMAS and standards
OHCSF Personnel Audit and Skills Gap Analysis project
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian federal civil-service skills identification, development and gap analysis
findings: The OHCSF PASGA portal describes a project to identify and develop the skills of Nigerian public servants and build a data-driven, globally competitive civil service.
source_summaries.limitations: The portal is public-service skills context and does not establish a private-sector requirement or a single certification.

source_summaries.name: Federal Government social-work professionalisation and standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian social-work practice, professionalisation, standards and capacity-building context
findings: The Federal Government described work to strengthen social-work practice in Nigeria, including professionalisation and standards challenges under the Social Work Practitioners Act 2022 context.
source_summaries.limitations: The article supports Nigerian practice context but does not establish one compulsory credential for every care, counselling or social-service role.

source_summaries.name: TRCN safeguarding resources for Nigerian schools
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian child protection, learner safety, violence-free schools and safeguarding practice
findings: TRCN provides resources on child protection, safety, security and violence-free schools and describes protocols and standards for protecting children and learners.
source_summaries.limitations: Safeguarding resources support education and child-facing practice; they do not create one universal certificate for all social-service or childcare roles.

source_summaries.name: Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria teacher standards and PQE
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian teacher education, accreditation, registration, professional qualifying examination and competency assessment
findings: TRCN describes its responsibility for teacher-education standards, programme accreditation, qualification approval, professional registration and competency assessment; its 2026 updates include PQE results and school-accreditation policy implementation.
source_summaries.limitations: TRCN applies to teaching practice within its mandate, not to every education, training, research or childcare role.
